conditions.evidence: Repository of Molecular Brain Neoplasia Data (REMBRANDT)
conditions.label: Molecular Brain Neoplasia

output.population: glioma specimens from the Glioma Molecular Diagnostic Initiative; pre-surgical MR images from 130 REMBRANDT patients
output.summary: Repository linking clinical information with genomic characterization of glioma specimens, including gene expression and copy number arrays and clinical phenotype data. This image collection adds pre-surgical multi-sequence brain MR images for a subset of patients.
